name: nwdesigns-mods
description: nwdesigns team mods: secret redaction, Secret Box, Blast Radius, collision guard, recording mode, completion check, plan-mode effort, a status band, Prompt Bouncer and Diagram Pane.

secretRedact.title: Secret redaction
secretRedact.description: Redact secrets in every tool result before the transcript stores it and the model reads it: the values of the project .env, .env.local and .env.production, the files in extraSecretFiles, and known token formats. A redaction failure withholds the result. Not a guarantee: unknown formats and split values pass.

extraSecretFiles.title: Extra secret files
extraSecretFiles.description: More files whose values are redacted, split by commas (~ allowed). A .json file is read as JSON, any other as KEY=value lines. Each one is required: if it cannot be read or parsed and no earlier values are cached, every tool result is withheld.

blastRadius.title: Blast Radius
blastRadius.description: Hold a risky Bash command (rm with -r or -f, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations, wp db reset/drop/import, wp search-replace on a non-local target, rsync --delete) and show what it would change, with Proceed and Cancel.

statusBand.title: Status band
statusBand.description: An attention list above the prompt, empty at rest: REC, a context at 50% or more, edits since the last check, a passed check. Only the buttons that apply, on keys 1 to 3.

collisionGuard.title: Collision guard
collisionGuard.description: Before a Write or Edit, ask when the file changed in the last collisionMinutes and not by this session (another session, an editor). Advisory: mtime does not prove who wrote it, and Bash writes are not covered.

collisionMinutes.title: Collision window
collisionMinutes.description: Minutes the collision guard looks back.

recording.title: Recording mode
recording.description: Register /rec: mask emails, keys, IBANs and amounts on screen in transcript messages and tool rows. Screen only, regex masks, not a security boundary.

completionCheck.title: Completion check
completionCheck.description: On Stop, check the last message for rationalization patterns. shadow: log to ~/.claude/logs/completion-check.jsonl only. block: refuse the stop once. off: nothing.

planXhigh.title: Plan mode xhigh
planXhigh.description: In plan mode, send each main-loop model request at xhigh effort. An /effort typed in the session turns it off for that session.

secretBox.title: Secret Box
secretBox.description: Give Claude a request_secret tool: you type a secret into a masked box, it is saved to the project .env, and Claude gets the variable name only. Also refuses git add or commit of a .env file, and @.env in a prompt.

promptBouncer.title: Prompt Bouncer
promptBouncer.description: In a repo with a GLOSSARY.md, a Haiku check compares each typed prompt with bouncerDocs and suggests the project term. warn: the prompt goes in at once, a toast shows the suggestion. block: the prompt is dropped with the suggestion; /force <prompt> sends it anyway. off: nothing.

bouncerDocs.title: Prompt Bouncer docs
bouncerDocs.description: Files relative to the project folder that the check reads, split by commas.

bouncerMaxChars.title: Prompt Bouncer docs limit
bouncerMaxChars.description: The maximum characters of bouncerDocs sent to the check.

diagramPane.title: Diagram Pane
diagramPane.description: A side pane that pins the mermaid and box diagrams Claude writes, and draws a map of the work. The map costs a Haiku call every diagramEveryTurns turns, and a session fork when the work changed shape.

diagramEveryTurns.title: Diagram Pane interval
diagramEveryTurns.description: Turns between two checks of the work map.
